periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-degree inward tilt relative to the horizontal facial axis, converging toward the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a width-to-height ratio of approximately 1:1.8 along the dominant axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced tapering at the inferior margin, extending toward the malar region.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Relatively flat U-shape across the dorsal midline from the observed anterior-lateral perspective.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Significant thickness, occupying approximately 40% of the visible upper torso verticality at the lateral flank.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation across the white cranial vault, approximately 1.5 to 2 times the width of an individual pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: High smoothness with a parabolic curvature at the superior margin of both ears.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced rufous/brownish pigmentation of the pelage across the lower ventral and abdominal regions.
